selection_rule: Derive required cases from actual features, claims, due gate and dependency impact; patterns do not exhaust product coverage. Bind concrete requirements/rules before execution.
case_fields_note: required_layers are planning layers, not canonical model modality enum; map through model-format.md at execution. due_gate is earliest usual proof gate; concept/model intent review may be earlier, later gates inherit still-applicable obligations.

cases.applies_when: The game has a controllable camera
cases.precondition_pattern: At a viewport boundary, an important object approaches from the direction of movement
cases.action_pattern: Move quickly, change direction and stop
cases.expected_observable_pattern: Movement and framing follow the camera specification. The hazard is readable before the required response window and the character stays visible.

cases.applies_when: Zoom, room transition or occlusion applies
cases.precondition_pattern: Near a transition trigger where foreground blocks the action area
cases.action_pattern: Cross the transition in both directions while holding touch input
cases.expected_observable_pattern: Control meaning and critical contact visibility persist. Cancellation or replay occurs only as defined.

cases.precondition_pattern: Two required gestures and a finger reaching the OS edge or safe area
cases.action_pattern: Press, hold, move, cancel and release. Background during hold and repeat at low FPS.
cases.expected_observable_pattern: One action has the declared meaning. Cancel and recovery prevent stuck input and unintended spending.

cases.precondition_pattern: A representative busy scene on a phone
cases.action_pattern: Perform the primary combination with two thumbs and repeat under the selected accessibility settings
cases.expected_observable_pattern: The player can reach required controls. Gestures remain distinct and important cues stay visible around thumbs.

cases.precondition_pattern: Two approved contexts with different constraints
cases.action_pattern: Compare the strongest simple strategy with one using the interaction. Remove the rule in the model.
cases.expected_observable_pattern: The decision changes in a specified way. Removing the rule eliminates the declared option or consequence.

cases.applies_when: There is competition for a resource
cases.precondition_pattern: Resource near its cap or empty, with two valid ways to spend it
cases.action_pattern: Spend the resource each way, interrupt recovery and repeat after loading
cases.expected_observable_pattern: Spending, recovery and persistence match the rules. The alternate choice changes what is possible.

cases.precondition_pattern: Agent starts without player knowledge, with defined perception limits and alert state
cases.action_pattern: Change visibility, noise and distance, and hide
cases.expected_observable_pattern: Knowledge, state and action change only through the declared perception and memory rules.

cases.precondition_pattern: Agent is ready at representative speed and scale
cases.action_pattern: Trigger the action and use an allowed dodge, interrupt or counter
cases.expected_observable_pattern: Telegraph, active window, hitbox and recovery align. Intended counterplay works and disallowed transitions remain blocked.

cases.precondition_pattern: Two agent families with an environmental modifier
cases.action_pattern: Check compatibility and player options in the defined geometry
cases.expected_observable_pattern: The combination supports declared counterplay or a route and prevents disallowed unavoidable chains.

cases.precondition_pattern: Several comparable contexts at the same progression tier
cases.action_pattern: Play each context without providing its intended strategy
cases.expected_observable_pattern: Observe distinct, readable decisions. A single simple strategy carries the declared tradeoff when applied across contexts.

cases.applies_when: Routes, gates or procedural generation apply
cases.precondition_pattern: Curated seeds: min/max resources; locked route; optional risk route
cases.action_pattern: Check reachability, escape, required resources and fallback
cases.expected_observable_pattern: The core objective is reachable within rules, higher and lower risk choices differ, and invalid seeds cannot reach players.

cases.precondition_pattern: An actor or tool affects a changeable material, prop or state
cases.action_pattern: Change the state and use it from a second system. Save and reload if persistence applies.
cases.expected_observable_pattern: State and consequences follow the causal contract. The world change affects a player decision.

cases.precondition_pattern: New profile, all prerequisite chains and a low-resource strategy
cases.action_pattern: Simulate key unlocks and check dependency cycles, caps and reset
cases.expected_observable_pattern: Essential rewards stay reachable without cycles under declared assumptions.

cases.precondition_pattern: The same existing task before and after unlock, with a save before purchase or reward
cases.action_pattern: Obtain the unlock, complete the old task through another valid route, and reload
cases.expected_observable_pattern: The new capability changes the declared decision, and persistence preserves a single unlock.

cases.precondition_pattern: Two contexts with different uses for the property and known stacking limits
cases.action_pattern: Change the property, combine boundary modifiers and repeat the base action
cases.expected_observable_pattern: Every retained property has a stated effect, with defined order, stacking and caps.

cases.precondition_pattern: Eligible reward, inventory near cap and known callback identity
cases.action_pattern: Claim, repeat claim, kill before and after commit and reload
cases.expected_observable_pattern: The reward is granted once under the rules. Caps, overflow and recovery preserve intended value.

cases.precondition_pattern: The player reaches a meaningful goal without an explanation from the researcher
cases.action_pattern: Receive and locate the reward and use it in the next context
cases.expected_observable_pattern: The player understands why it was awarded, what changed and what they can do next.

cases.precondition_pattern: New profile, actual first-time participant and clean install
cases.action_pattern: Complete the first useful action, failure, retry and reward without coaching
cases.expected_observable_pattern: Goal, controls, errors, retry and next milestone are understandable. Record assistance and dropoff.

cases.precondition_pattern: The skill has been introduced and another encounter requires it
cases.action_pattern: Hide repeated hints according to rules and observe the transfer task
cases.expected_observable_pattern: Observe independent use in a new context or record a learning gap. Track hint dismissal separately.

cases.applies_when: Accepted visual, audio or motion references exist
cases.precondition_pattern: Match scene, state, seed, camera, aspect ratio and agreed tier
cases.action_pattern: Capture frames and motion, listen to actual mix and test physical haptics if applicable
cases.expected_observable_pattern: Accepted scope and tolerances hold, cues are readable and style, movement and sound preserve the approved baseline.

cases.applies_when: Player navigation and state transitions apply
cases.precondition_pattern: Each loading, empty, failure, locked or unlocked state, with guest and returning profiles when relevant
cases.action_pattern: Exercise forward, back, cancel, retry and deep links. Interrupt transitions.
cases.expected_observable_pattern: The player avoids softlock and lost progress, understands outcome and recovery, and can use localized safe-area layouts.

cases.precondition_pattern: Early/mid/late/post-mastery; declared content budget
cases.action_pattern: Walk the progression and content graph and evaluate assumptions about repetition and exhaustion
cases.expected_observable_pattern: Release scope is finite and concrete, new situations change decisions, and mastery leads to the declared finale or voluntary next goals.

cases.precondition_pattern: New unlock and earlier optional objective with known reward rules
cases.action_pattern: Return voluntarily and follow a newly available route or goal
cases.expected_observable_pattern: Goal and value are clear, return stays optional, and reward and state persist.

cases.precondition_pattern: Eligible, ineligible, expired and owned offer states, with local price available and unavailable
cases.action_pattern: Open the shop, try within rules, decline or buy and test stale pricing
cases.expected_observable_pattern: Exact contents, limits, duration and price appear before commitment. Decline restores normal play and trial follows declared reset and refill rules.

cases.precondition_pattern: Sandbox transaction pending/cancelled/failed/successful; verification outage
cases.action_pattern: Reorder and repeat callbacks and kill and restart around verification, grant and acknowledgement
cases.expected_observable_pattern: Only verified purchase grants durable entitlement. Duplicate prevention persists, pending grants no access, and reconciliation reaches a known outcome.
cases.oracle_source_kind: current store contract; transaction state machine

cases.applies_when: Entitlements can be restored or refunded
cases.precondition_pattern: Sandbox purchase; reinstall/account switch; refund/revoke
cases.action_pattern: Restore and repeat, refund or revoke, switch between two devices, and test a consumed consumable
cases.expected_observable_pattern: Restore and revocation follow entitlement type. Consumed items stay consumed and saves follow policy.

cases.precondition_pattern: Ad eligible/ineligible; no-fill/timeout/consent denied/offline
cases.action_pattern: Decline/close-before-earned/earned; duplicate callback; unload/kill before reward
cases.expected_observable_pattern: Decline and no-fill preserve the free core. A verified earned event grants once within limits and cooldown.

cases.precondition_pattern: Never-pay and full-paid portfolios with skilled, low-time and low-skill strategies
cases.action_pattern: Compare acquisition, power, access and attempt limits and strongest combined offers
cases.expected_observable_pattern: The strongest combination respects declared limits, overlap and expiry and preserves the free route without unexplained advantage or budget reset.
cases.oracle_source_kind: commerce fit; cumulative portfolio; free-path contract

cases.precondition_pattern: Historical supported saves; partial/truncated data; low storage; offline conflict
cases.action_pattern: Upgrade, kill across atomic boundaries, retry migration and merge guest and account where applicable
cases.expected_observable_pattern: Preserve data and prevent duplication. Repeated migration stays safe. Backup, recovery and incompatible boundaries match policy.

cases.precondition_pattern: Minimum representative device; worst-case actors/FX/audio/UI/collection; accepted tier
cases.action_pattern: Sustained session; profile frame times/memory/thermal; interruptions/network changes
cases.expected_observable_pattern: Meet budgets in declared conditions and preserve critical cues under degradation. Restrict claims to measured devices.

cases.applies_when: Data collection, accounts or SDKs apply
cases.precondition_pattern: Actual SDK and data map with denied consent, deletion and revocation as applicable
cases.action_pattern: Compare network and runtime with disclosures and exercise deletion, error and retry
cases.expected_observable_pattern: Collected data and permissions match disclosures. Verify deletion independently from logout and exclude personal data and secrets from evidence.
cases.oracle_source_kind: privacy data inventory; current platform rules

cases.applies_when: Live diagnosis has been requested after release
cases.precondition_pattern: Actual provider export with time window, build, cohort and denominator
cases.action_pattern: Separate bots, internal and sandbox activity and check missing or duplicate events and schema drift
cases.expected_observable_pattern: The query reproduces the scoped finding. Separate observation and hypothesis and leave D1/D7 or revenue unknown without live data.
